column1: # samsho4 (MAME 0.286, neogeo -cart1 samsho4, -bios euro) from a backup RAM of 64 KiB of random bytes, without the signature:
# jig of $D00100 (writes, REG_SRAMLOCK/UNLOCK, watchdog kicks, resets), then bench/son.lua for the fix layer. Image 65051ec0…
# (before the fix) and the SNK BIOS. On a new, all-zero NVRAM both show no WARNING: this is why the bench had not seen it.
# Our image formatted $D00000-$D0007F only, then wrote the signature; the SNK BIOS tests and clears all of it (patterns
# $5555, $AAAA, then a value, then $0000 at $D00100). After the run, 64,361 non-zero bytes of 65,536 under our image, 3,464
# under the SNK BIOS. Request 0 itself is the same under both: game write of $0000 with the lock closed (no effect), game
# unlock, no more kicks, watchdog reset 8 frames later ($D00100 is not written again).
